# Bencho

> Bencho (bencho.dev) is a library of interactive React UI components and micro-interactions. Every block is live, not a recording: it can be played with, tuned with its own controls, and its source copied into a project.

- Built with React, TypeScript and framer-motion.
- The blocks are MIT licensed: https://bencho.dev/license
- 184 blocks, each with its own page, live demo and adjustable values; most include their full source to copy.
- Finds: a curated gallery of UI interactions by other designers, credited to their makers.
- Sounds: a library of synthesised sounds for UI interactions.
- Bench: a canvas for arranging and tuning blocks side by side.
- Made by Lorenzo Cabra. On X: @benchodev.

## Sections

- [Blocks](https://bencho.dev/): the full wall of interactive components
- [Finds](https://bencho.dev/finds): curated interactions from around the web
- [Sounds](https://bencho.dev/sounds): UI sound library
- [Bench](https://bencho.dev/bench): the workbench canvas
- [Licence](https://bencho.dev/license): terms of use
- [About](https://bencho.dev/about): who makes Bencho and how to reach them (hello@bencho.dev)

## Blocks

- [Thinking orb](https://bencho.dev/blocks/thinking-orb) (AI Thinking Orb: a Dot Sphere That Spins or Weaves): An AI thinking indicator for React, drawn on a canvas. A sphere of dots turns in 3D, nearer dots larger and darker. Spinning sets the dots on swaying meridians, and Weaving sets them on rings that breathe, both over a shimmering Thinking label. Pointing at it wakes it up. Good for AI assistants, voice input and chat apps.
- [Elastic slider](https://bencho.dev/blocks/elastic-slider) (Elastic Slider: Range Slider That Stretches Like Rubber Past Its Ends and Springs Back): An opacity pill you drag; pull past either end and it stretches like rubber, then springs back with a little overshoot.
- [Live vote](https://bencho.dev/blocks/live-vote) (Live Vote: a Poll Whose Options Turn Into Live Results): A team poll: vote and every option turns into its result, bars filling, numbers counting up, a few voters coming in. Press another option to move your vote, or yours again to take it back.
- [Confirm send](https://bencho.dev/blocks/confirm-send) (Send Money Confirmation Card with a Warm Glow): A send money confirmation card for React that shows the amount, the recipient and the fee before a transfer goes out. When you press send, a warm glow fills the card while it works, then it flips over to a receipt with the time the money arrived. It suits banking apps, wallets and any payment flow.
- [Huddle](https://bencho.dev/blocks/huddle) (Voice Room UI: Join a Huddle): A voice room component for React, made for calls and audio chats. Press join and your avatar pops into the room while the others make space, and a soft ring pulses around whoever is speaking. A good fit for team chat apps, community spaces and live audio features.
- [Stories](https://bencho.dev/blocks/stories) (Stories Card with a Segmented Progress Bar): A stories card for React with a segmented progress bar, like the ones in social apps. Each page plays over its own image and moves on by itself as the bar fills. Tap a side to skip, hold to pause, and set how long each page stays. Useful for onboarding, product updates and highlights.
- [Liquid tooltip](https://bencho.dev/blocks/glide-tip) (Liquid Tooltip That Flows Between Buttons): A liquid tooltip for React that flows between icon buttons instead of jumping from one to the next. It grows out of the button you hover, slides along the row as you move, and drains away when the pointer leaves. It works well for toolbars, docks and icon navigation.
- [Password reveal](https://bencho.dev/blocks/pass-reveal) (Password Show Hide Animation, Dot by Dot): A password field for React with a show and hide toggle, animated one character at a time. Press the eye icon and each dot turns into its letter in order, then press again and they go back to dots from the last one. A small detail that makes sign in and sign up forms feel more polished.
- [Race bars](https://bencho.dev/blocks/race-bars) (Bar Chart Race: Market Caps and Populations): An animated bar chart race for React that shows the largest companies by market cap or countries by population over time. Bars grow, the year counts up and rows swap places as one overtakes another. You can drag the timeline to scrub, change the pace and switch between colour and grey.
- [Path panel](https://bencho.dev/blocks/path-panel) (Settings Panel UI: a Row That Is Its Own Slider): A compact settings panel for React where each row is its own control. Drag along a row to set its value like a slider, tap the colour row to cycle through swatches, and flip a switch for on and off options. Good for editors, design tools and app preferences.
- [Income flow](https://bencho.dev/blocks/income-flow) (Income Chart: a Flowing Ribbon of Months): An income chart for React that shows a month's total above a flowing ribbon of past months. The ribbon widens and narrows with the money, hovering marks the month under the pointer, and clicking morphs it into the next year. Made for finance dashboards, budgeting apps and earnings pages.
- [Audio trim](https://bencho.dev/blocks/wave-trim) (Audio Trim UI: a Draggable Waveform Frame): An audio trim component for React built around a draggable waveform. Drag either edge of the frame to cut a recording, and it snaps to where speech starts or stops. Play back the selection bar by bar, then save it with a colourful wave. Useful for voice notes, podcasts and audio editors.
- [Dice](https://bencho.dev/blocks/dice) (3D Dice Roller: Flick, Tumble and Land): A 3D dice roller for React with real cubes that tumble and land. Press to roll, or pick the dice up and flick them, and the total appears once they settle. Roll one, two or three dice, with a colour shimmer when you get doubles. Fun for board games, giveaways and playful interfaces.
- [3D bar chart](https://bencho.dev/blocks/pillars) (3D Bar Chart: Sales Against Target): A 3D bar chart for React that compares sales against a target by day, month or year. Each target is a dashed box in perspective, and hovering one grows a solid box inside it to show what was actually made. Set the depth from flat bars to deep blocks. Good for sales dashboards and KPI reports.
- [Market chart](https://bencho.dev/blocks/market-chart) (Prediction Market Chart with a Hover Hairline): A prediction market chart for React with two or three outcomes drawn as live lines. Hover any moment and a hairline drops, each line shows its chance at that point, and the rest of the chart fades back. Place a bet and the lines move with it. Built for trading, forecasting and polling apps.
- [Seat map](https://bencho.dev/blocks/seat-map) (Seat Picker: a Plane Cabin Seat Map): A seat picker for React laid out like a plane cabin. Tap a free seat to choose it and tap again to let it go, with up to two seats at a time and the price shown underneath. Useful for airline, train, cinema and event booking flows.
- [Score gauge](https://bencho.dev/blocks/gauge) (Credit Score Gauge with Ticks and a Drag Lens): A credit score gauge for React, drawn as a half circle of ticks from poor to excellent. It sweeps up to the score, and you can drag around the arc to move it, with the ticks swelling near the pointer and a label naming the band. Made for finance apps, health scores and progress meters.
- [AI Assistant](https://bencho.dev/blocks/listen) (AI Chat Assistant UI with a Voice Glow): An AI chat assistant interface for React with suggested prompts, a glowing voice mode, a thinking state and a reply that streams in. Pick warm or cool colours and set how strong the glow is. A ready starting point for chatbots, copilots and voice assistants.
- [Hold to delete](https://bencho.dev/blocks/hold-delete): A hold to delete button for React that asks for a long press before anything is removed. The pill fills while you hold it, the bin starts to shake near the end, and letting go early drains it back. Set the hold time, the rewind speed and the shake. A safer pattern for destructive actions.
- [FAQ frames](https://bencho.dev/blocks/faq-frames) (FAQ Accordion in Frames, Where the Open Question Stays Solid): An FAQ accordion for React where every question sits in its own frame. Open one and its answer slides in with a little bounce while the other questions fade back, so the open one stays easy to read. Good for help pages, pricing pages and product sites.
- [Status picker](https://bencho.dev/blocks/status-picker) (Status Picker: a Badge That Opens Into Statuses): A status picker for React that opens from a small badge on an avatar. Press the badge and a row of statuses opens around it, hover one to see its name, and pick it to fold the row back into the badge. You can also type a custom status. Suits chat apps, team tools and profiles.
- [Card stack](https://bencho.dev/blocks/card-stack) (Card Stack: a Photo Deck That Fans Out on Hover): A card stack for React that fans a deck of photos out as the pointer gets close. Hover to lift a card, click to flip it into the centre, and click away to put it back on top. Adjust the spread, the number of cards and how scattered they look. Nice for galleries, portfolios and product showcases.
- [Arc ring](https://bencho.dev/blocks/expenses) (Expenses Ring Chart: Spending by Category): An expenses ring chart for React that shows a month of spending by category. Each arc is as long as its share, and hovering one makes it grow while the others make room and the total in the middle changes to that figure. Made for budgeting apps, banking dashboards and finance reports.
- [Format bar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/format-bar) (Formatting Toolbar with Joined Toggle Groups): A text formatting toolbar for React with bold, italic, underline and alignment controls. Active buttons join into one shape, the alignment highlight glides between options, and the paragraph below changes smoothly instead of jumping. Useful for rich text editors, note apps and comment boxes.
- [Jelly tabs](https://bencho.dev/blocks/jelly-tabs) (Jelly Tabs: a Segmented Picker That Wobbles): A segmented control for React shown as a playback speed picker. The selected pill stretches to its new size like jelly and settles with a small wobble you can tune. A playful take on tabs for video players, audio apps and settings.
- [Odds](https://bencho.dev/blocks/odds) (Odds Card: Yes or No Market With a Chance Line): A yes or no prediction market card for React. Move along the line to see how the chance changed over time, then hold Yes or No to buy and watch the split shift your way. Built for betting, forecasting and polling products.
- [Progress tracker](https://bencho.dev/blocks/progress-tracker) (Progress Tracker: Getting-Started Checklist): A getting started checklist for React with a progress bar that fills as tasks are done. Ticking a task crosses it out, the bar springs forward and the count rolls up, and finishing them all sets off a small burst on every row. Great for onboarding flows and setup guides.
- [Thinking loader](https://bencho.dev/blocks/thinking-loader) (Thinking Loader: an AI Status Pill): A thinking loader for React, the small status pill an AI model shows while it works. Rays turn, the label rolls through each step and a check lands at the end. Press it to see the steps, and set how long each one shows. Made for AI chat apps, agents and copilots.
- [Genie effect](https://bencho.dev/blocks/genie) (Genie Effect: Photos That Pour Out of a Dock): A genie effect for React that pours photos out of a dock and back again. Press a thumbnail and the image flows up out of its slot into the viewer, then close it and it funnels back down where it came from. Nice for galleries, file browsers and desktop style interfaces.
- [Flap board](https://bencho.dev/blocks/flap-board) (Split-Flap Board: an Airport Departures Display in React): A split flap board for React, styled like an airport departures display. Press it and the next message sweeps across the board flap by flap, or brush over it to make the flaps riffle. Set the flap speed and how a message travels. Fun for landing pages, dashboards and announcements.
- [Image trail](https://bencho.dev/blocks/image-trail) (Image Trail: Photos That Follow Your Cursor): An image trail effect for React where photos follow the cursor. Move across the area and a new photo drops in every few steps, then fades out a moment later. Adjust the spacing, the photo size and how each one leaves. Popular for portfolios, agency sites and creative landing pages.
- [Dust delete](https://bencho.dev/blocks/dust-delete) (Dust Delete: a Photo That Blows Away as Dust When You Bin It): A delete animation for React that turns a photo into dust when you bin it. The grains blow away on the wind until the image is gone, and the next photo grows in to take its place. Choose the effect, the wind direction, the grain size and the speed. A memorable touch for galleries and file managers.
- [Slingshot](https://bencho.dev/blocks/slingshot) (Slingshot: Pull Back and Fling an Elastic Ball): A slingshot interaction for React where you pull back an elastic band and fling a ball. The band stretches and trembles at its limit, and once you let go the ball flies, bounces off the walls and comes back. Tune the power and the bounce. A fun toy for games, empty states and playful sites.
- [Crumpled receipt](https://bencho.dev/blocks/crumple) (Crumple Paper Effect, Built with Three.js): A crumple paper effect for React, built with Three.js and starring a receipt. Press the receipt and it scrunches into a ball of paper, then throw the ball into the bin in the corner and a fresh one prints. You can set how far it tilts and how hard a flick throws. Fun for checkout pages, order confirmations and playful empty states.
- [Price chart](https://bencho.dev/blocks/price-chart) (Crypto Price Chart: Scrub, Then Morph to Candles): A crypto price chart for React that you scrub with the pointer to read the price and change at any point. Switching ranges morphs one line into the next, and the line can grow into candles and fold back again. Choose green and red or a single ink colour, with the price above or below. Made for trading apps, wallets and market dashboards.
- [Standing calendar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/standing-calendar) (Standing Calendar: a Commit Heatmap in 3D): A commit heatmap for React shown as a standing calendar in 3D. Half a year of commits rises from a flat calendar into a skyline of bars, each as tall as its day, and you can point at a day or drag to turn it. Days can be squares or circles, in blue or plain ink. Good for developer profiles, activity pages and GitHub style dashboards.
- [Orders globe](https://bencho.dev/blocks/orders-globe) (Orders Globe: a Dotted World of Live Orders): A dotted globe for React that shows live orders around the world. Each city gets a dot sized by its share, you can spin the globe by dragging, and a pill switches between today, this week and this month. You can set how often new orders land and how fast it turns. Works well in ecommerce dashboards, sales reports and analytics pages.
- [AI autocomplete](https://bencho.dev/blocks/ai-autocomplete) (AI Autocomplete: Ghost Text, Tab to Accept): An AI autocomplete text field for React with ghost text you accept with Tab. The rest of the sentence waits in grey after the caret, Tab takes all of it, the right arrow takes one word, and pressing any grey word takes it up to there. You can set the pause before it suggests. A good fit for writing tools, email apps and AI editors.
- [Magnetic letters](https://bencho.dev/blocks/magnetic-letters) (Magnetic Letters: Type That Leans to the Cursor): Magnetic letters for React, a line of type that leans towards the cursor. As the pointer comes close the nearest letters lean in, tilt its way and darken, then spring back into the line when you move off. Pull, reach and tilt are all adjustable. Nice for hero headings, portfolio sites and landing pages.
- [Selection actions](https://bencho.dev/blocks/selection-actions) (AI Selection Actions: Explain and Improve Text): AI selection actions for React that appear as a pill under selected text. Choose rewrite and the new words arrive out of a blur, or open the pill into a note. You can set how long the rewrite takes to arrive. Useful for AI writing assistants, document editors and note taking apps.
- [Loading state](https://bencho.dev/blocks/loading-state) (Agent Loading State: Pixel Grid Loader): An agent loading state for React built around a small pixel grid loader. While the agent works it shows nine moving pixels, a shimmering word for what it is doing and a count of the seconds so far. The pixels can drive, dot or orbit. Made for AI chat apps, coding agents and any tool where a task takes a while.
- [Private balance](https://bencho.dev/blocks/private-balance) (Private Balance Card: Hide Digits, Hold to Peek): A private balance card for React that hides the digits and lets you hold to peek. Swipe between accounts and each balance spins in like a slot wheel, tap it to hide it digit by digit, and hold to see it again. Digits can be masked with dots, dashes or blur. Suited to banking apps, wallets and finance dashboards.
- [Spec inspector](https://bencho.dev/blocks/spec-inspector) (Spec Inspector: Reveal a Card's Blueprint): A spec inspector for React that reveals a card's blueprint. Drag a frame over a settings card and it turns into its own blueprint, measured off the real layout, then melts back when you let go. A good fit for design tool sites, developer portfolios and design system docs.
- [Context meter](https://bencho.dev/blocks/context-meter) (Context Meter: a Token Window as One Bar): A context meter for React that shows a token window as one stacked bar, or as a field of dots. Point at a kind of content to light it up, and press Compact to squeeze the chat down with a sound to match. It comes in colour or mono. Made for AI chat apps, LLM tools and usage dashboards.
- [Load cards](https://bencho.dev/blocks/load-cards) (Load Cards: Skeleton Cards That Develop): Skeleton loading cards for React that develop one after another. Three result cards arrive as skeletons, easing in out of a blur with a light running over their bars, then the bars blur away and the real content comes into focus. Press play to load them again, and set the pace and blur. Good for search results, feeds and AI answers.
- [Ink bloom](https://bencho.dev/blocks/ink-bloom) (Ink Bloom Slider: WebGL Image Transition): An ink bloom image slider for React with a WebGL transition. Press anywhere on the photo and the next picture blooms out from that point like ink spreading through water, with a ragged edge and a thin lens bending the image behind. Edge and speed can both be adjusted. Works well for portfolios, galleries and product showcases.
- [Peek rating](https://bencho.dev/blocks/peek-rating) (Peek Rating: Stars That Rise Under the Pointer): A star rating for React where the stars rise under the pointer. Run along the five stars and every one up to the pointer lifts, the one under it grows, and a tip names the score before you press to set it with a pop. Choose stars or hearts, in yellow or ink. Useful for reviews, feedback forms and product pages.
- [Edge light](https://bencho.dev/blocks/edge-light) (Edge Light: a Border That Glows Toward the Cursor): An edge light effect for React, a border that glows towards the cursor. It frames a painting whose rim catches the light as the pointer moves out to an edge, with a short arc glowing in candlelight and travelling round with you. Choose candle, rosé or screen colour and set the glow. Nice for galleries, featured cards and portfolio pieces.
- [Line sidebar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/line-sidebar) (Line Sidebar: Ruler-Style Table of Contents): A line sidebar for React, a table of contents drawn like a ruler. Run the pointer down it and the nearest lines reach out while their names lean in, the effect falling off across the neighbours. You can set how many rows it spreads across and how far lines reach. Made for docs, long articles and blog posts.
- [Gravity tags](https://bencho.dev/blocks/gravity-tags) (Gravity Tags: Tag Pills in a Physics Pile): Gravity tags for React, tag pills that fall into a physics pile. A shower of tags or orbs lands, tipping and stacking, and running the pointer through pushes them aside or scatters them if you sweep fast. Count, gravity and push are adjustable, in colour or mono. Fun for skills sections, portfolios and playful landing pages.
- [Falling text](https://bencho.dev/blocks/falling-text) (Falling Text: Words That Fall Into a Physics Pile): Falling text for React, where words drop into a physics pile. Two lines of text come apart when the pointer touches them, the words tumble into a pile you can throw about, and then they fly back into the sentence. You can set how hard the words fall. A good fit for hero sections, 404 pages and creative portfolios.
- [Card swap](https://bencho.dev/blocks/card-swap) (Card Swap: 3D Card Stack That Sends the Front Card to the Back): A 3D card stack for React that sends the front card to the back. Press or fling the front photo card and it goes straight to the back while the rest step forward, or turn on Auto to have it swap by itself every few seconds. Works well for feature showcases, testimonials and image galleries.
- [Dot swarm](https://bencho.dev/blocks/dot-swarm) (Dot Matrix Chart with Hover Scrub Tooltip): A dot matrix chart for React with a hover scrub tooltip. Activity by hour is drawn as swarms of dots round a line, and as you run along it the column under the pointer swells and reads out. Density and the number of rows can be adjusted. Useful for monitoring tools, alert dashboards and analytics pages.
- [Option wheel](https://bencho.dev/blocks/option-wheel) (Option Wheel: a Curved Drum Picker): An option wheel for React, a curved drum picker for words. The chosen word sits in the middle while the rest tilt away, softer and out of focus, and you spin it by scrolling, dragging or using the arrow keys. Tilt and blur are adjustable. Good for settings, onboarding steps and mobile style pickers.
- [Wake slider](https://bencho.dev/blocks/wake-slider) (Wake Slider: Thumbless Range Slider): A thumbless range slider for React made of thin bars. There is no handle to grab, and when you drag fast the bars you sweep past spring up in a wake behind your hand. You can set the number of bars and how high they rise. Made for audio controls, settings panels and creative tools.
- [Line sphere](https://bencho.dev/blocks/line-sphere) (3D Line Sphere Morphing Shapes with Hover Canvas Animation): A 3D line sphere for React, a canvas animation that morphs between shapes. Fine lines of light form a globe, a sphere and a flat ring, a click flows from one to the next, and moving the pointer through them parts the lines. Line count, reach and sway are adjustable. Nice for hero sections, AI product pages and landing pages.
- [Page peel](https://bencho.dev/blocks/page-peel) (Page Curl Corner Peel Drag Interaction): A page curl effect for React with a corner you drag to peel. The top corner of the page is turned down, and peeling it back reveals a note hidden underneath, then the page falls flat when you let go. You can set the resting curl, the reach and the bounce. Fun for invitations, hidden offers and playful portfolios.
- [Stacked bars](https://bencho.dev/blocks/stacked-bars) (Stacked Bar Chart with Hover Tooltip): A stacked bar chart for React with a hover tooltip. It shows a month of visits, and as you run along the bars one day is ringed while a tooltip glides beside it, with a Day and Week switch that regrows the bars. Bar count and gap are adjustable. Suited to analytics dashboards, admin panels and reports.
- [Network graph](https://bencho.dev/blocks/blast-radius) (Radial Network Graph with Hover Path Highlight): A radial network graph for React with hover path highlighting. You sit in the middle with your network around you ring by ring, resting on a node lights its path back to you, and switching from Near to All grows the outer ring. Nodes can be circles or squares. Made for social apps, CRM tools and relationship maps.
- [Integrations](https://bencho.dev/blocks/connect-sources) (Connect Integrations Onboarding Card): A connect integrations onboarding card for React. Six tools sit in a grid, and pressing one connects it, its sparkline syncing from dotted to solid while the setup bar climbs. Press again to disconnect it. You can set how many start connected. Useful for SaaS onboarding, settings pages and data source setup.
- [Blueprint loader](https://bencho.dev/blocks/blueprint-loader) (Blueprint Loading Animation for AI Results): A blueprint loading animation for React that suits AI results. It draws the plan of a profile card on a dot grid, rules and boxes measured off the real card, then blends the finished card in over it. You can set how quickly it draws. A good fit for AI tools, profile lookups and generated content.
- [AI chat input](https://bencho.dev/blocks/ai-chat-input) (AI Chat Input with Model and Effort Pickers): An AI chat input for React with model and effort pickers. The prompt bar stretches from a pill into a box when pressed, with a model menu and an effort setting below, and the mic turns into a send arrow as you type. The attach button, model menu and effort step can each be switched off. Made for chatbots, AI assistants and agent tools.
- [FAQ accordion](https://bencho.dev/blocks/faq-accordion) (FAQ Accordion with Smooth Expanding Answers): An FAQ accordion for React with smooth expanding answers. Press a question and its answer slides open with the words easing in one after another, while the plus turns into a cross. Pick a plus or a chevron, and choose whether only one stays open at a time. Useful for help centres, pricing pages and product sites.
- [Avatar group](https://bencho.dev/blocks/avatar-group) (Avatar Group with a Sliding Name Tooltip): An avatar group for React with a sliding name tooltip. Five faces sit in an overlapping row, and as you point along them the row lifts round the pointer while one tooltip slides to each name. Lift, grow and overlap are adjustable. Good for team pages, shared documents and collaboration tools.
- [Profile hover card](https://bencho.dev/blocks/profile-card) (Profile Hover Card with Follow Button and Mutuals): A profile hover card for React with a follow button and mutuals. Four faces sit in a box showing who liked your post, resting on one grows their card out from under it, and running along the faces changes person. You can set the delay before it opens. Works well in social apps, comment threads and community sites.
- [Resizable panels](https://bencho.dev/blocks/resizable-panels) (Resizable Panels with Draggable, Keyboard-Ready Dividers): Resizable panels for React with draggable dividers that also work from the keyboard. Drag a divider and the panes trade width, resist at their minimum and fold away past it, in a two or three panel layout. Made for dashboards, email clients, code editors and admin tools.
- [Toast stack](https://bencho.dev/blocks/toast-stack) (Stacked Toast Notifications that Fan Out on Hover): Stacked toast notifications for React that fan out on hover. Three toasts sit at the edge with the two behind peeking out above the front one, and pointing at them springs them apart into a list. Peek, gap and corner radius can be adjusted. Useful for web apps, admin panels and any interface that shows alerts.
- [Dot loader](https://bencho.dev/blocks/dot-loader) (Matrix Dot Loader Animation): A matrix dot loader animation for React on a four by four grid. The dots light up in one of four looping patterns, scan, twinkle, orbit or pulse, and you can leave the corners out for a rounded shape and set the speed. A good fit for loading screens, AI tools and buttons waiting on a response.
- [Image shimmer](https://bencho.dev/blocks/image-shimmer) (Image Loading Shimmer Placeholder): An image loading shimmer placeholder for React. Light wanders across the placeholder on a loop, and its edge catches the light as it passes. Speed and corner radius are adjustable. Good for galleries, product grids, feeds and anywhere images take a moment to load.
- [Shimmer text](https://bencho.dev/blocks/shimmer-text) (Shimmer Text Loading Animation): A shimmer text loading animation for React. A short line such as Thinking has a band of ink sweeping across it on a loop, and pressing it moves on to the next phrase. You can set how fast the band sweeps. Made for AI chat apps, agents and any status message that waits on a reply.
- [Orbit cards](https://bencho.dev/blocks/orbit-cards) (3D Orbit Card Carousel): A 3D orbit card carousel for React with white cards round a turning band. Seen from the front, one card faces you while two bend away at the sides, and you can drag the band round or flick it. Speed and tilt are adjustable. Works well for feature tours, product showcases and portfolios.
- [Metaballs](https://bencho.dev/blocks/metaballs) (Metaballs Lava Lamp Animation): A metaballs lava lamp animation for React, with glowing orbs that drift across the card. Where two meet they merge, then stretch and neck apart again, and your pointer joins in as one of the orbs. Pick blue, red or green and set how many orbs there are, how far they glow and how fast they move. Nice as a hero background or an ambient landing page detail.
- [Tree view](https://bencho.dev/blocks/tree-view) (Animated File Tree View): An animated file tree view for React that lays out a project's files and folders. Folders slide open beneath themselves, and a press picks a file. You can change how far each level steps in, turn on guide lines down open folders and round the corners. Made for code editors, developer tools, file managers and documentation sites.
- [Access request](https://bencho.dev/blocks/access-request) (Access Request Toast that Expands into a List): An access request toast for React that starts as a small pill of people waiting to join. Press it and it opens into a list where each person has Approve and Reject buttons. The speed of the opening and how much the card swells and gathers can both be adjusted. A good fit for team workspaces, shared documents and admin panels.
- [Code reveal](https://bencho.dev/blocks/code-reveal) (ASCII Code Reveal Image Hover Effect): An ASCII code reveal hover effect for React that turns an image into text under the cursor. Move over the picture and it becomes black and white characters drawn from the image itself, with a slow rain running through them. Reach, linger time and character size are all adjustable. Works well on portfolios, agency sites and creative landing pages.
- [Budget slider](https://bencho.dev/blocks/budget-slider) (Performance Budget Slider with Color-Coded Bars): A performance budget slider for React that compares a page's load time with its target. Drag along the bars and they fill green when under budget, amber when a little over and red when well over, swelling where your finger rests. The budget line itself can be moved. Useful for web performance dashboards, monitoring tools and developer reports.
- [Emoji reactions](https://bencho.dev/blocks/emoji-reactions) (Animated Emoji Reactions with a Flying Picker): Animated emoji reactions for React with a picker that flies each choice into place. Press the button and the message turns into a pill of emoji, then pick one and it travels down to its reaction chip while the count rolls up. Choose a work, classic or hearts set and adjust the magnify and bounce. Good for chat apps, comment threads and team messaging.

- [Tilt card](https://bencho.dev/blocks/tilt) (3D Tilt Card Hover Effect): A 3D tilt card hover effect for React with a twist, since the photo card sinks under your pointer instead of rising toward it. You can set how far it turns, how deep the dent looks and the card's corner radius. Good for portfolios, product cards, galleries and playful landing pages.
- [Now playing](https://bencho.dev/blocks/sound) (Music Player Widget): A music player widget for React that starts as a small now playing bar. Press it and the bar opens into a full player, then folds back down as one piece. The corner radius of the sleeve and how quickly it opens can be changed. Made for music apps, podcast players and media dashboards.
- [Dragging ball](https://bencho.dev/blocks/drag-ball) (Draggable Squishy Ball): A draggable squishy ball for React that reacts like something soft. Grab it and it swells under the pointer, squeezes while you hold it and stretches as it moves. Stretch, size and how quickly it rounds back out are adjustable. Fun for playful interfaces, loading screens and interactive demos.
- [Search](https://bencho.dev/blocks/seek) (Expanding Search Bar): An expanding search bar for React that starts as a single icon. Press the icon and it opens into a search field as one object, with a spring setting for how the width settles. Corners and how far it leans toward the cursor can be tuned too. Suits navigation bars, headers and compact toolbars.
- [Pull to refresh](https://bencho.dev/blocks/pull) (Pull to Refresh): A pull to refresh component for React built around a stretchy card. Pull the card down and it stretches, and if you let go past the line it refreshes with a spinning ring. You can adjust the corner radius and how fast the ring turns. Made for feeds, inboxes and mobile style web apps.
- [Escape button](https://bencho.dev/blocks/escape) (Runaway Button): A runaway button for React that slides away from your cursor when you try to reach it, and then gives up. You can set how hard it pushes away and how close you need to get. A light joke for April Fools pages, games, 404 pages and playful marketing sites.
- [Slosh slider](https://bencho.dev/blocks/slosh) (Liquid Fill Slider): A liquid fill slider for React where the fill has weight. Drag fast and the fill sloshes past the handle before settling, and it can coast on after release. Momentum, tilt and how loose the liquid feels are adjustable. Works well for volume, brightness and other settings in playful or media apps.
- [Create menu](https://bencho.dev/blocks/liq-create) (Gooey Create Menu): A gooey create menu for React that starts as a single pill. Press it and the pill spreads into the full create menu, as if the menu was inside it all along. The corner radius can be adjusted. A good fit for editors, dashboards and apps with a main new item button.
- [Reorder list](https://bencho.dev/blocks/liq-arrange) (Drag to Reorder List): A drag to reorder list for React with a liquid feel. Drag a row to a new position and neighbouring rows fuse together like liquid as it passes. You can set how much a flung row deforms. Useful for playlists, task lists, settings and any list people sort by hand.
- [Canvas toolbar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/toolbar) (Floating Canvas Toolbar): A floating canvas toolbar for React, the kind found in drawing and design apps. Its shape tool remembers the last shape you picked, so the next press uses it again. The corner radius is adjustable. Made for whiteboards, diagram editors, design tools and annotation apps.
- [Radial menu](https://bencho.dev/blocks/radial) (Radial Menu): A radial menu for React that keeps tools tucked behind one button. Press the centre and the tools fan out around it in a half circle. You can change how many tools there are, the radius and arc of the fan, and how far apart they deal out. Good for drawing apps, games and touch interfaces.
- [Drag stepper](https://bencho.dev/blocks/stepper) (Number Stepper with Drag): A number stepper with drag for React that handles both small and large changes. Tap for a single step, or hold and drag to sweep through values quickly. Works well for quantity pickers in shops, booking forms, settings and design tools.
- [Inline confirm](https://bencho.dev/blocks/confirm) (Inline Delete Confirmation): An inline delete confirmation for React that avoids a separate dialog. Press Delete and the button turns into its own confirm, then offers an undo once the item is gone. The corner radius is adjustable. Useful for lists, file managers, inboxes and admin tables.
- [Notify](https://bencho.dev/blocks/toasts) (Notify Me Button): A notify me button for React with a small animated bell. Press Notify and the bell swings while the button stays pressed to show you are signed up. The corner radius can be changed. Made for product launch pages, back in stock alerts, waitlists and event reminders.
- [Icon bar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/icon-bar) (Animated Tab Bar): An animated tab bar for React built from icons. When you pick a new tab, the selection pill stretches across to it and lands with a small bounce. Stretch, bounce and speed can all be tuned, and the bar can run as a row or a column. Suits mobile navigation, sidebars and app toolbars.
- [Magnifying dock](https://bencho.dev/blocks/dock) (macOS Magnifying Dock): A macOS magnifying dock for React with icons that grow as your cursor passes. The nearest icon grows most and its neighbours swell less, with settings for magnification, lift and how many icons either side respond. Good for app launchers, portfolio navigation and desktop style web interfaces.
- [Progress ticks](https://bencho.dev/blocks/progress) (Tick Slider): A tick slider for React made from a row of small marks. Scrub along the ticks to set a value, and the change is shown as you go. A good fit for settings panels, media controls, ratings and any form that needs a value picked from a range.
- [Wheel](https://bencho.dev/blocks/humidity) (Circular Dial Slider): A circular dial slider for React with a ring of ticks. Drag around the ring to set a value and the lit band follows your finger. Tick density, sweep and an optional wave motion can be adjusted. Made for smart home apps, thermostat and humidity controls and other dashboard gauges.
- [Command bar](https://bencho.dev/blocks/command) (Command Bar): A command bar for React that grows out of a button. Press the button and it fuses into a command field with a liquid effect, then slides back out when you are done. You can tune how far it stretches before breaking free and how sharp the edge is. Useful for productivity apps, dashboards and developer tools.
- [Selection list](https://bencho.dev/blocks/roster) (Multi-Select List): A multi-select list for React for picking people. Tap names to select them, and once there is at least one choice a button grows out ready to continue. Good for sharing dialogs, group chats, team invites and assigning work.
- [Range dial](https://bencho.dev/blocks/sleep) (Circular Range Slider): A circular range slider for React with two handles on a dial. Drag either handle around the ring to set the range between them, with the handles snapping to steps of five, fifteen or thirty. Tick density and reach can be adjusted too. Works well for sleep trackers, scheduling and time window settings.
- [Liquid toggle](https://bencho.dev/blocks/liq-toggle) (Liquid Toggle Switch): A liquid toggle switch for React with a droplet for a thumb. Flip it and the droplet stretches as it slides across the track, then rounds out at the other end. You can set how much it lengthens as it moves. A good fit for settings pages, preference panels and playful apps.
